Ravi S: Hey team — day 1. M1 Pro, default zsh. Followed the dotfiles bootstrap but hitting two blockers: 1) `asdf install ruby 3.1.4` fails with native extension / openssl / libyaml errors; 2) bootstrap script fails cloning private infra repo: `Permission denied (publickey)`. Any quick troubleshooting pointers?

Carla D: Welcome! For Ruby builds: `brew install openssl@3 libyaml readline libffi` then set configure opts before install: `export RUBY_CONFIGURE_OPTS=\"--with-openssl-dir=$(brew --prefix openssl@3) --with-readline-dir=$(brew --prefix readline)\"` and then `asdf install ruby 3.1.4`. Also try `brew link --force readline` if header lookup fails.

Ravi S: I tried that but asdf still picks up system OpenSSL. I also have an old rbenv that might interfere. The bootstrap does `asdf reshim` at the end but `which ruby` still shows /usr/bin/ruby.

Marco T: Move or remove rbenv first: `mv ~/.rbenv ~/.rbenv.bak` and remove any rbenv init lines in your zshrc. Make sure `~/.asdf/shims` is early in PATH: `export PATH="$HOME/.asdf/shims:$HOME/.asdf/bin:$PATH"` in `~/.zshrc`. After that run `asdf reshim ruby` and `asdf global ruby 3.1.4` then `exec $SHELL` to reload.

Ravi S: Got it. About the SSH failure: bootstrap tries `ssh-add -K ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and then `git clone git@github.com:redwood/infra.git` -> Permission denied. My SSH keys are in 1Password but I couldn't find the new-hire entry.

Carla D: On modern macOS use `ssh-add --apple-use-keychain ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`. Check `chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and `chmod 644 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub`. Also confirm the key is uploaded to your GitHub account. 1Password entry should be `redwood/new-hires/ssh`; ops will add you if missing.

Ravi S: The bootstrap also created `.envrc` as executable and direnv now complains `permission denied to execute hooks/.envrc`. Is .envrc supposed to be executable?

Marco T: No, direnv just reads `.envrc` as a plain file. Make it readable and non-executable: `chmod 644 .envrc` then `direnv allow`. If the file is a symlink pointing to a script, ensure the target permissions are correct.

Ravi S: Who should I ping to get 1Password and repo access sorted? Also should I uninstall rbenv or just move it?

Carla D: Ping me or @Marco T in DMs and we'll fast-track the dotfiles sync + repo access. Safe to move rbenv out of the way (`mv ~/.rbenv ~/.rbenv.bak`) until you're sure. We'll update the bootstrap to check for rbenv in the next patch.

ops-bot: Created ticket OPS-2245 to add Ravi S to 1Password 'redwood/new-hires/ssh' and request repo access. Assigned to @Carla D. :gear:

Ravi S: Thanks y'all — fixing perms and moving rbenv now. Will report back if anything else breaks. :raised_hands:
